name: month
description: Reference month of the observation, from 1 to 12

name: day
description: Reference day of the month, from 1 to 31

name: country_id
description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the country the series refers to
observations: NULL for the global daily GPR series; USA for the daily EPU series

name: index_family
description: Index family: epu (Economic Policy Uncertainty) or gpr (Geopolitical Risk)

name: index_name
description: Coded identifier of the specific index series; labels are in the dicionario table

name: value
description: Value of the index for the given series and date
observations: Index points (base = 100 in the series' reference window)
